data.description:
Write RED tests for the new mode-detect.sh behavior before implementation changes.

## Testing Mode: RED

## File to Create
tests/scripts/test-mode-detect.sh

## Test Functions to Write (all must FAIL before Task 2 implementation)
1. test_mode_detect_returns_ci_pr_when_dso_workflow_ci_pr — config has dso.workflow=ci-pr, script outputs "ci-pr"
2. test_mode_detect_returns_local_when_dso_workflow_local — config has dso.workflow=local, script outputs "local"
3. test_mode_detect_forwards_config_path_via_env — DSO_CONFIG_PATH override honored (passes WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE to read-config.sh)
4. test_mode_detect_exits_nonzero_on_missing_config — no config file, script exits non-zero (read-config.sh exits 1 for missing dso.workflow)
5. test_mode_detect_legacy_keys_absent — old enforcement.strategy/merge.strategy keys in config without dso.workflow= do not produce "ci-pr" (shim handles legacy, but test baseline is clean dso.workflow)

## Notes
- Suite runner guard: test file must not run test_ functions when sourced, only when executed directly.
- Set executable bit: chmod +x tests/scripts/test-mode-detect.sh
- Follow behavioral-testing-standard.md: test observable behavior, not implementation

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 5 test functions exist and FAIL (exit non-zero) when run against the UNMODIFIED current mode-detect.sh
- Test suite runner exits non-zero to confirm RED state
